kind: named prism planar face frame verification

results.go_oracle: Six cube face normals recorded from Go analytic planes.
results.history: Named frames checked for all six faces at 10 mm and 20 mm, undo, redo and Rust recipe reopen; stale and wrong-kind keys refused.

observations: The provenance-generated side face is Forward while its unique solid occurrence is Reversed. The query uses the solid occurrence orientation.
For Go side 1, Go in-plane axes are (0,0,1) and (0,-1,0), while kernel-derived axes are (0,1,0) and (0,0,1). Origin and normal agree, but legacy sketch coordinates need an explicit basis mapping.
limitations: This provides a named prism face frame only. It does not migrate a Go face key, import the dependent work plane, or prove arbitrary non-prism support.
The Go axis witness is an observational printout; Rust assertions compare the six analytic origins and normals, not matching in-plane axes.
No full gate or foreground user journey was run.
